name: Run Starlark Script
description: Execute a Starlark (Python-like) script to transform data and route playbook branches, replacing a graph of nodes with a single script. The script must define `def main(arguments):` and return a JSON-serialisable value.

script.title: Script
script.description: Starlark script defining `def main(arguments): ...` that returns the result. `arguments` is the input object below.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Input object passed to the script as `arguments` (typically wired from previous playbook nodes).

outputs.left: Fires when the script calls output("left").
outputs.default: Fires by default (centered); carries the returned results to the next node.
outputs.right: Fires when the script calls output("right").
